rationale: Only one proven universal common source scale may be calibrated into GM; relative/range/readout/source pieces stay residual.
gamma, beta, alpha1, alpha2, alpha3, xi now each have explicit missing kernel rows and comparator bounds.
beta cannot be inferred from WEP or gamma; it needs a second-order source-normalized field equation or finite source kernel.
alpha3 has a 4e-20 comparator and catches source-current/nonconservation leaks that WEP can miss.
All PPN response kernels are schema/nonclaim; no model row is score-ready.
